30373-life-and-literature-over-two-thous.title: In Alphabetical Order
30373-life-and-literature-over-two-thous.creator: Unknown
30373-life-and-literature-over-two-thous.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It is told of Admiral Collingwood that on his travels he carried a bag of acorns, and dropped one wherever there seemed a likely spot for an oak to grow, that England might never lack ships.

arxiv-1805-06623.title: Beam-based detector alignment in the MICE muon beam line
arxiv-1805-06623.creator: François Drielsma
arxiv-1805-06623.description: Abstract Muon Ionization Cooling Experiment August 9, 2026 The Muon Ionization Cooling Experiment (MICE) will perform a detailed study of ionization cooling to evaluate the feasibility of the technique. To carry out this program, MICE requires all of its detectors to reconstruct space points in a globally consistent fashion.

arxiv-2104-04040.title: Scaling up graph homomorphism for classification via sampling
arxiv-2104-04040.creator: Paul Beaujean, Florian Sikora, Florian Yger
arxiv-2104-04040.description: Abstract Feature generation is an open topic of investigation in graph machine learning. In this paper, we study the use of graph homomorphism density features as a scalable alternative to homomorphism numbers which retain similar theoretical properties and ability to take into account inductive bias.

arxiv-2209-12517.title: Structure and Phase Transitions of Metastable Hexagonal Uranium Thin Films
arxiv-2209-12517.creator: Rebecca Nicholls, Chris Bell, Johann Bouchet, Ross Springell, Gerard H. Lander
arxiv-2209-12517.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Rebecca Nicholls, Chris Bell, Johann Bouchet, Ross Springell, Gerard H. Lander. We report a simple technique for the synthesis of uniaxially textured, metastable hexagonal close-packed-like uranium thin films with thicknesses between 175 − 2800 175-2800 Å. The initial structure and texture of the layers have been studied via X-ray diffraction and reflectivity and the time-dependent transitions of the samples into various orientations of orthorhombic α \alpha -U have been mapped by similar techniques.

arxiv-2308-12988.title: Graviton detection and the quantization of gravity
arxiv-2308-12988.creator: Daniel Carney, Valerie Domcke, Nicholas L. Rodd
arxiv-2308-12988.description: Abstract We revisit a question asked by Dyson: “Is a graviton detectable?” We demonstrate that in both Dyson’s original sense and in a more modern measurement-theoretic sense, it is possible to construct a detector sensitive to single gravitons, and in fact a variety of existing and near-term gravitational wave detectors can achieve this.

arxiv-2403-02202.title: Exploring Interactive Color Palettes for Abstraction-Driven Exploratory Image Colorization Conference: Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 11–16, 2024; Honolulu, HI, USA Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’24), May 11
arxiv-2403-02202.creator: Xinyu Shi, Mingyu Liu, Ziqi Zhou, Ali Neshati, Ryan Rossi, Jian Zhao
arxiv-2403-02202.description: Abstract . Color design is essential in areas such as product, graphic, and fashion design. However, current tools like Photoshop, with their concrete-driven color manipulation approach, often stumble during early ideation, favoring polished end results over initial exploration. We introduced Mondrian as a test-bed for abstraction-driven approach using interactive color palettes for image colorization.

arxiv-2408-10387.title: Neural Infalling Cloud Equations (NICE): Increasing the Efficacy of Subgrid Models and Scientific Equation Discovery using Neural ODEs and Symbolic Regression 2024 Neural Infalling Cloud Equations (NICE): Increasing the Efficacy of Subgrid Models and Scientific Equation Discovery using Neural ODEs a
arxiv-2408-10387.creator: Brent Tan
arxiv-2408-10387.description: Abstract Galactic systems are inherently multiphase, and understanding the roles and interactions of the various phases is key towards a more complete picture of galaxy formation and evolution. For instance, these interactions play a pivotal role in the cycling of baryons which fuels star formation.

arxiv-2506-08635.title: SurfR: Surface Reconstruction with Multi-scale Attention
arxiv-2506-08635.creator: Siddhant Ranade * University of Utah and Gonccalo Dias Pais Instituto Superior Técnico and Ross Tyler Whitaker University of Utah and Jacinto C. Nascimento Instituto Superior Técnico and Pedro Miraldo Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories and Srikumar Ramalingam Google Research
arxiv-2506-08635.description: Abstract We propose a fast and accurate surface reconstruction algorithm for unorganized point clouds using an implicit representation. Recent learning methods are either single-object representations with small neural models that allow for high surface details but require per-object training or generalized representations that require larger models and generalize to newer shapes but lack details, and inference is slow.

britannica-1911-skene-william-forbes.description: Article 'Skene, William Forbes' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. and antiquary, was the second son of Sir Walter Scott’s friend, James Skene (1775–1864), of Rubislaw, near Aberdeen, and was born on the 7th of June 1809. He was educated at Edinburgh High School, in Germany and at the university of St Andrews, taking an especial interest in the study of Celtic philology and literature.

europmc-pmc4489293.title: OrthoVenn: a web server for genome wide comparison and annotation of orthologous clusters across multiple species.
europmc-pmc4489293.creator: Wang Y, Coleman-Derr D, Chen G, Gu YQ.
europmc-pmc4489293.description: Genome wide analysis of orthologous clusters is an important component of comparative genomics studies. Identifying the overlap among orthologous clusters can enable us to elucidate the function and evolution of proteins across multiple species. Here, we report a web platform...

plos-pone-0011735.title: The Association of Alcohol and Alcohol Metabolizing Gene Variants with Diabetes and Coronary Heart Disease Risk Factors in a White Population
plos-pone-0011735.creator: Lise Lotte N. Husemoen, Torben Jørgensen, Knut Borch-Johnsen et al.
plos-pone-0011735.description: PLOS ONE research article. Epidemiological studies have shown a J- or U-shaped relation between alcohol and type 2 diabetes and coronary heart disease (CHD). The underlying mechanisms are not clear. The aim was to examine the association between alcohol intake and diabetes and intermediate CHD risk factors

pmc-10591651.title: P033 Assessment of Upper Airway Dilator Muscle Function and Collapsibility in People with Multiple Sclerosis with Versus without Sleep Apnea
pmc-10591651.creator: E Thomas, A Osman, L Calonzo, L Hall, M Agzarian, M Slee
pmc-10591651.description: IntroductionUpper airway reflex responses to negative pressure are important to prevent upper airway narrowing and closure. Recent evidence indicates ~30% of people with multiple sclerosis (MS) have an impaired upper airway dilator reflex response. Thus, the aims of this study were to compare genioglossus muscle reflex responses and upper airway collapsibility in non-obese people with MS, with and without OSA.

pmc-10650503.title: A Comparative Study between Onion Peel Extracts, Free and Complexed with β-Cyclodextrin, as a Natural UV Filter to Cosmetic Formulations
pmc-10650503.creator: Mariana A Messias, Sara M Ferreira, Loleny Tavares, Lúcia Santos, David Arráez-Román
pmc-10650503.description: The growing concern regarding the adverse effects of synthetic UV filters found in sunscreens has spurred significant attention due to their potential harm to aquatic ecosystems and human health. To address this, the present study aimed to extract and microencapsulate sensitive bioactive compounds derived from by-product onion peel (OP) by molecular inclusion using β-cyclodextrin as the wall material.

pmc-11413251.title: Demographics and outcomes of patients younger than 75 years undergoing aortic valve interventions in Rotterdam
pmc-11413251.creator: Rik Adrichem, A. Maarten Mattace-Raso, Thijmen W. Hokken, Mark M. P. van den Dorpel, Marjo J. A. G. de Ronde, Mattie J. Lenzen, Paul A. Cummins, Isabella Kardys, Rutger-Jan Nuis, Joost Daemen, Jos A. Bekkers, Nicolas M. Van Mieghem
pmc-11413251.description: BackgroundTranscatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) is considered a safe and effective alternative to surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR) for elderly patients across the operative risk spectrum. In the Netherlands, TAVI is reimbursed only for patients with a high operative risk. Despite this, one fifth of TAVI patients are < 75 years of age.

pmc-11454711.title: 12227 The Battle Between Central And Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus
pmc-11454711.creator: A A Luzuriaga Chavez, J P Hidalgo, A Rao, N Patel
pmc-11454711.description: Disclosure: A.A. Luzuriaga Chavez: None. J.P. Hidalgo: None. A. Rao: None. N. Patel: None.Diabetes insipidus (DI) is a rare disorder characterized by excessive polyuria and polydipsia. The two main types include central diabetes insipidus (CDI), which results from antidiuretic hormone (ADH) deficiency and nephrogenic diabetes insipidus (NDI), defined by ADH resistance in the renal tubules.

pmc-11632524.title: A Three Month Assessment of Anthropogenic Litter Levels on the Illinois River, Tahlequah, Oklahoma
pmc-11632524.creator: Emma C. Mills, Katherine M. Wollman, Elizabeth F. Waring
pmc-11632524.description: Anthropogenic litter is one of the most important factors that influence recreation users and their activities because of its correlation to the river and environmental health. We monitored pollution levels on the Illinois river, near Tahlequah, OK for three months and surveyed the publics opinion on the issue.

pmc-11690933.title: GAMEPLAN4CARE AND RESOURCES4CARE: PRELIMINARY OUTCOMES ASSOCIATED WITH TWO ONLINE DEMENTIA CAREGIVING PROGRAMS
pmc-11690933.creator: Alan Stevens, Jinmyoung Cho, Jordan Reese, Gang Han, Marcia Ory
pmc-11690933.description: GamePlan4Care (GP4C) and Resources4Care (R4C) are online dementia caregiver programs. GP4C consists of rules-based conditional logic algorithms and real-time assessments of caregiving risks to tailor and prioritize educational and skills content. R4C provides a searchable database of vetted online educational and resources focused on dementia and family caregiving.

pmc-12446566.title: Efficiency of Epidermal Grafts in Chronic Wounds: A Retrospective Observational Study
pmc-12446566.creator: S Bruyeres, G Dumas, N Zenati, S Blaise
pmc-12446566.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and AimsChronic wounds represent a major challenge in medical management, requiring effective therapeutic approaches to promote healing. In recent years, epidermal grafts have emerged as a promising therapeutic option to improve the healing process of chronic wounds. This device only allows ultrasuperficial grafts to be performed using a suction/suction mechanism with a dermo‐epidermal cleavage zone, unlike other superficial grafting techniques such as pellet or mesh grafts.

pmc-12490507.title: DISTRIBUTION OF RESPIRATORY VIRUSES IN CHILDREN ADMITTED TO PEDIATRIC INTENSIVE CARE UNIT
pmc-12490507.creator: Gokhan Ceylan, Ozlem Sandal, Ferhat Sari, Rana Isguder, Ahu Kara, Gamze Gülfidan, Yuce Ayhan, Ilker Devrim, Hasan Ağın
pmc-12490507.description: SUMMARYAcute lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) is common in children and associated with high morbidity and mortality. The aim of this study was to determine the distribution of respiratory viruses leading to admission of a child with the diagnosis of LRTI to pediatric intensive care unit (PICU).

pmc-12577042.title: The effect of fatigue on static and dynamic balance in healthy young male athletes: a randomized trial
pmc-12577042.creator: Anwar B Almutairi, Abdullah Alabdulwahab, Maraheb Alkhalidi, Saleh Alnouri, Mohammed Alkatan
pmc-12577042.description: PurposeThe aim of the study is to assess the effect of a running fatigue protocol on static (SB) and dynamic balance (DB) abilities using Wii balance board (WBB) and Y-balance (YB) tests, respectively, in young male recreational athletes.Materials and MethodsParticipants were randomized into control and experimental groups. They were examined on static and dynamic balance (pre- & post-tests).

pmc-12596087.title: The nitro-chloro substitution on two quinolinone-chalcones: from molecular modeling to antioxidant potential
pmc-12596087.creator: Renata Layse G de Paula Master, Jean M F Custódio, Caridad Noda-Pérez, Allen G Oliver, Hamilton B Napolitano
pmc-12596087.description: The current demand for sustainable energy sources leads us to consider the possibility of biofuels, such as biodiesel, which are more environmentally desirable and align with some of the Sustainable Development Goals.¹ Biodiesel stands out as a more environmentally friendly option, as it presents lower levels of pollutants during combustion.

pmc-12604140.title: Surgical approaches in total hip arthroplasty do not influence the bacterial spectrum of acute postoperative periprosthetic joint infections
pmc-12604140.creator: Jonas Tumler, Dominic Simon, Gautier Beckers, Alexander C Paulus, Boris M Holzapfel, Jörg Arnholdt
pmc-12604140.description: Introduction: With the increasing number of primary total hip arthroplasties (THAs), the incidence of associated complications has risen, with periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) being among the most severe. The influence of surgical approach on infection risk remains debated; however, its effect on the microbiological profile of PJIs is not well examined.

pmc-12649558.title: The Relationship Between Emotion Malleability Beliefs and School Adaptation of Middle School Boarders: A Chain Mediating Effect of Psychological Resilience and Peer Relationships
pmc-12649558.creator: Yixuan Han, Shiyu Zheng, Xuehong Chen, Jing Zhang, Yao Meng
pmc-12649558.description: Middle school boarders are more prone to maladjustment to school due to a lack of parental accompaniment and long school hours. Focusing on this specific group, this study explored the effects of emotion malleability beliefs on their adjustment to school and their influential pathways, and constructed a hypothetical model with resilience and peer relationships as chain mediators.

pmc-12732119.title: Pseudo-Sample Generation and Self-Supervised Framework for Infrared Dim and Small Target Detection
pmc-12732119.creator: Jinxin Guo, Weida Zhan, Dehua Huo, Depeng Zhu, Yu Chen, Yichun Jiang, Xiaoyu Xu, Jun Chen
pmc-12732119.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Infrared dim and small target detection is crucial for long-range sensing. However, its deep representation learning is severely constrained by the scarcity of accurately annotated real data, and related research remains underdeveloped. Existing data generation methods based on patch synthesis or geometric transformations fail to incorporate the physical degradation mechanisms of infrared imaging systems and reasonable environmental constraints, leading to significant discrepancies between synthetic data and real-world scenarios.

pmc-13277716.title: Cost-effectiveness of single-dose versus two-dose HPV vaccination: a Markov cohort modelling analysis of a Kenya–India LMIC composite
pmc-13277716.creator: Jinyao Wang, Xiaolan Wang, Jie Xu, Qiuxiang Xu
pmc-13277716.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCervical cancer imposes a disproportionate burden in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where second-dose dropout substantially limits the real-world effectiveness of two-dose HPV vaccination programmes. Single-dose schedules eliminate dropout but provide shorter-duration protection.

pmc-13457907.title: Volume ratio factor: a novel CT-derived biomarker for pre-planning ipsilateral lung dose risk stratification in breast cancer radiotherapy
pmc-13457907.creator: Qianqian Meng, Zhongzhi Qi, Zheng Li, Birong Hu, Guijun Xue, Renming Zhong
pmc-13457907.description: BackgroundIpsilateral lung dose in breast cancer radiotherapy is typically evaluated only after treatment planning, limiting early risk stratification and planning optimization. This study aimed to develop and validate a novel computed tomography (CT)-derived volumetric biomarker, the volume ratio factor (VRF), for pre-planning assessment of ipsilateral lung dose risk in breast cancer radiotherapy.
